column2: what does spirit do|what is spirit for|spirit stat|explain spirit
column3: Spirit is mainly associated with health and mana regeneration. Its value depends on your class and build.

column2: what does stamina do|what is stamina for|stamina stat
column3: Stamina increases your maximum health.

column2: what does intellect do|what is intellect for|intellect stat
column3: Intellect increases mana for mana-using classes and contributes to spell critical chance in this ruleset.

column2: what does strength do|what is strength for|strength stat
column3: Strength affects melee attack power for several classes and can contribute to shield blocking.

column2: what does agility do|what is agility for|agility stat
column3: Agility affects armour, dodge and critical strike chance, with attack-power benefits depending on class.

column2: what does armour do|what is armor for|what is armour for|armour stat
column3: Armour reduces incoming physical damage. It does not provide the same protection against spells.

column2: what is hit chance|what does hit do|miss chance explanation|how does hit work
column3: Hit chance helps attacks and spells avoid missing. Exact requirements depend on level and target.

column2: what does defense do|what does defence do|defense skill|defence skill
column3: Defence skill influences avoidance and the chance enemies critically hit you.

column2: how does threat work|what is threat|how does aggro work|what is aggro
column3: Threat determines which party member an enemy is likely to attack. Tanks try to hold it while others manage theirs.

column2: what does taunt do|how does taunt work|what is taunting
column3: Taunt makes an enemy focus the tank for a short time and interacts with the threat table. It is not a permanent threat lead.

column2: what is line of sight|what does los mean|line of sight pulling|what is los
column3: Line of sight means whether a character can see a target for attacks or spells. Tanks can use corners to gather ranged enemies.

column2: what does cc mean|what is crowd control|why crowd control
column3: CC is crowd control: abilities that temporarily disable or restrict enemies so the group handles fewer threats at once.

column2: what is interrupting|how do interrupts work|why interrupt
column3: Interrupting stops an enemy cast when timed correctly. The interrupt must be available and in range.

column2: what does aoe mean|what is aoe
column3: AoE means area of effect: an ability that affects multiple targets or an area.

column2: what does cooldown mean|what is a cooldown
column3: A cooldown is the time you must wait before using an ability again.

column2: what does dps mean|what is dps
column3: DPS means damage per second, or describes a party role focused on damage.

column2: what does a tank do|what is a tank role|what does tank mean
column3: A tank tries to control enemy attention and survive incoming damage while the group fights.

column2: what does a healer do|what is a healer role|what does healer mean
column3: Healers restore health, remove certain harmful effects and manage mana during fights.

column2: what does pull mean|what is a pull in dungeon|what does pulling mean
column3: A pull begins combat with a selected enemy or pack, ideally under the group's control.

column2: what is a ready check|how does ready check work
column3: A ready check asks group members whether they are prepared to proceed.

column2: how many players in a party|party size limit|what is a party
column3: A standard WoW party has up to five members.

column2: what is a raid group|what is a raid|raid party difference
column3: A raid is a larger organised group used for raid encounters. Vanilla raids can have up to forty members.

column2: what is a hearthstone|how does a hearthstone work|hearthstone teleport
column3: A hearthstone returns you to your bound inn or home location, subject to its cooldown.

column2: what are flight paths|how do flight paths work|what is a flight master
column3: Flight masters provide transport between discovered flight points for a fee.

column2: what does an innkeeper do|what is an innkeeper
column3: An innkeeper can set your hearthstone location. Resting in an inn also helps accumulate rested experience.

column2: what is rested xp|how does rested experience work|what does rested mean
column3: Rested experience gives a bonus to experience from eligible kills while rested points remain. Inns and cities accumulate it faster.

column2: how do corpse runs work|what happens when you die|corpse run explained
column3: After dying, you can generally return to your corpse as a ghost or use a spirit healer, with different consequences.

column2: how does durability work|what happens when gear breaks|how do i repair gear
column3: Equipment loses durability through play and death. Repair vendors restore it for money.

column2: what is the bank for|how does bank storage work|where do i store items
column3: Bankers provide storage beyond your carried bags. You can access it at banks in major settlements.

column2: what is a mailbox for|how does mail work|send items by mail
column3: Mailboxes let you send in-game messages, money and permitted items to other characters.

column2: how does auction house work|what is an auction house|how do auctions work
column3: Auction houses let players list items for others to bid on or buy, usually with fees.

column2: what does soulbound mean|what is soulbound|why is item soulbound
column3: Soulbound items are tied to a character and generally cannot be traded to another player.

column2: what does bind on equip mean|what is boe|bind on equip explanation
column3: Bind on Equip items become soulbound when equipped, rather than when first obtained.

column2: what is bind on pickup|what does bop mean|bind on pickup explanation
column3: Bind on Pickup items become soulbound when acquired.

column2: what do item colours mean|what does green gear mean|item quality colours
column3: Common WoW item quality colours include white for common, green for uncommon, blue for rare and purple for epic.

column2: how many professions can i learn|primary professions limit|how many main professions
column3: Characters can normally learn up to two primary professions, alongside secondary skills.

column2: how does mining work|what does mining do|where to learn mining
column3: Mining gathers ore from mineral nodes. Learn it from a mining trainer and carry the required tools where applicable.

column2: what is skinning for|how does skinning work|how do i skin mobs
column3: Skinning collects hides and leather from eligible slain creatures after they have been looted.

column2: how does herbalism work|what is herbalism for|how do i pick herbs
column3: Herbalism gathers herbs from nodes in the world. Herbs are often used in Alchemy.

column2: what does alchemy do|how does alchemy work
column3: Alchemy uses gathered materials to create potions, elixirs and other consumables.

column2: what does enchanting do|how does enchanting work
column3: Enchanting applies magical improvements to eligible equipment and can disenchant many items.

column2: what is first aid for|how do bandages work|first aid skill
column3: First Aid creates bandages for healing outside direct spellcasting. Bandages cannot be used repeatedly without a short lockout.

column2: how do i fish|how does fishing work|what is fishing for
column3: Fishing catches fish and other items from bodies of water using a fishing skill and rod.

column2: how does cooking work|what is cooking for
column3: Cooking prepares food that restores health and sometimes provides temporary benefits.

column2: how to tell bots follow|how do i make bots follow|bot follow command
column3: For your TortoiseBots party use .bot action follow, or ask them to follow in normal chat if the command bridge is enabled.

column2: how to make bots buff|how to rebuff party|bot rebuff command
column3: Use .bot action rebuff to refresh expiring group buffs, or ask the party to rebuff in chat.

column2: how to stop bots attacking|stop bot combat command|bot action stop command
column3: Use .bot action stop to clear current attacks and combat queues.

column2: how to inspect a bot|how to see bot inventory|bot inv command
column3: Use .bot inv followed by the bot's name to inspect its equipment and inventory.

column2: how to whisper bots|how do i send bot commands|bot whisper commands
column3: You can whisper a bot directly or use .bot command followed by its name and a supported command.

column2: what is stormwind|where is stormwind
column3: Stormwind is the human capital city in Elwynn Forest in the Eastern Kingdoms.

column2: what is orgrimmar|where is orgrimmar
column3: Orgrimmar is the orc capital city in Durotar on Kalimdor.

column2: what is ironforge|where is ironforge
column3: Ironforge is the dwarf capital city in Dun Morogh.

column2: what is darnassus|where is darnassus
column3: Darnassus is the night elf capital on Teldrassil in the classic-era world.

column2: what is scarlet monastery|where is scarlet monastery
column3: Scarlet Monastery is a dungeon complex in Tirisfal Glades. Its wings have different recommended levels.

column2: what are the deadmines|where are the deadmines
column3: The Deadmines are a low-level dungeon in Westfall, accessed through the mine near Moonbrook.

column2: where are the wailing caverns|what are wailing caverns
column3: Wailing Caverns is a low-level dungeon in the Northern Barrens.

column2: where is ragefire chasm|what is ragefire chasm
column3: Ragefire Chasm is a low-level dungeon inside Orgrimmar.

column2: where is blackrock depths|what is blackrock depths
column3: Blackrock Depths is a large high-level dungeon within Blackrock Mountain.

column2: where is stratholme|what is stratholme
column3: Stratholme is a high-level dungeon in the Eastern Plaguelands.
